rationale.consistency: Highly idiomatic Go, perfectly matching the style, flag handling, and conventions of the zoekt codebase.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles relative paths, duplicate names, and dry runs flawlessly, but misses printing usage text when failing due to missing root arguments.
rationale.scope: Implements all core requirements, subcommands, and indexer preservation, but slightly misses the explicit 'prints usage' requirement on empty args.
rationale.readability: Excellent modularity, clear variable names, and well-commented functions that explain non-obvious logic.
rationale.robustness: Safely manages dry runs, locking, and external command execution without panicking or modifying state unintentionally.
rationale.maintainability: Well-structured subcommand parsing and clean separation of discovery from indexing make the tool very easy to maintain.
